train.input: Ticket: Someone is logging into the administrator account from an unfamiliar IP address and downloading our customers' personal information. Please address this immediately.
Ticket: All login requests in production return 503. Users cannot access the system right now.
Ticket: The same order was charged twice. Please refund the extra charge.
Ticket: This is my first time using the system. How do I export the project member list?
Ticket: Please add a dark theme in the future. All features currently work normally.

Ticket: Yesterday's login problem has been resolved. Today I only want to know where to configure two-factor authentication.
Ticket: I want to check last month's bill, but the consoles for all tenants are currently inaccessible, and refreshing keeps returning 502.

validation.input: Ticket: The administrator key was just made public, and someone is still using it to read the customer database. We also have a duplicate charge.
Ticket: The earlier failed payment has been resolved, but the production API is now timing out continuously, preventing business operations from calling it.
Ticket: The application works normally and there is no security incident. We bought an annual plan but are also being charged repeatedly each month. Please check and refund the charges.
Ticket: The old API key was revoked as planned; it was not leaked, and existing services work normally. Please tell me how to create a new key.
